adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the diff replaces `refreshTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(responseJson)` plus an explicit `console.error(...)` on failure with `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)`, which throws on parse failure without logging the raw MS response. The subsequent line `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }` is now redundant because `parseRefreshTokenResponse` throws when `success` is false, so `success &&` is effectively dead-guard logic left over from the old safeParse flow. This is not a functional defect, but it is a real maintainability/diagnostics regression grounded in the diff.
